## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Fix Shelly Energy `last_reset` attribute for devices that energy is reset upon device reboot.
- At startup calculate `last_reset` from device uptime.
- When previous energy value is largeer than new energy value (device reboot or wraparound) set `last_reset` to current time.

`last_reset` is rounded to by minutes to avoid changes in value due to drift.

I can confirm this issue. The problem concerns devices that lose energy value on restart (so Shelly EM and 3EM are not affected).
We are working on a fix. Thank you for your patience.

Just to let you know : I have experienced the same problem. And even after the latest 2021.09 update, it was still not working. And finally, I've had an idea : my Shelly is on a network that does not have internet connection. So, the default NTP server (the one of Google) was not reachable. And therefore, the Shelly had no knowledge of the current time.
Once I change the NTP server, it worked.

So, to sum up, this kind of problem can also be caused by no time configured on the device.

(not sure if it is good practice to add comment on a closed ticket. But didn't find anywhere else a report of similar problem)

You are my hero, @MagicalTrev89 !
It also working in my configuration.
The missing NTP was the problem.
